Source-view and navigation corrections preserve separate issuer dependencies and never supply posting authority. exit_state: The representation now separates immutable observations,contextual mappings,dated company relationships and eligible source views. Extraction,translation,model admission and accounting eligibility are distinct decisions. The JPMorgan wrong-reference example has introduced conflicting printed targets156 and163; its inspection and correction continue next.
findings: The observation fields follow financial examples and preserve literal text,context,units,times and uncertainty. Substantially all remains qualitative unless a threshold is explicitly assumed.
Concept mappings distinguish equivalence,components,containment,reclassification and measurement. Geography/channel partitions of260 cannot be added to520 or used to infer joint cells.

Source traversal has explicit cycle and resource bounds while unresolved incorporated references remain visible. Original,latest and harmonized views preserve contextual supersession rather than selecting by ingestion recency.

Four review decisions are distinguished with FIFO and depreciation examples. The ASBE substitution-right presumption is stated as a conditional rule,not a license to fill missing facts. No confirmed new defect;section3.10 remains incomplete.
